name: Resolve-Codec-Converter
creator: MohammedBoulifa
category: Encoding, codecs, proxy generation, rendering, and project servers
description: Linux batch transcoding GUI for H.264/H.265, DNxHR and ProRes, including PCM audio conversion and a video-passthrough audio mode. Useful for preparing footage for Resolve Free on Linux. The x64 AppImage bundles PyQt5/Qt5; FFmpeg must be installed separately. Release tag is a build label, not a numeric version.
